As part of our procurement security review for MedSecure Health, we need the following from Redwood to complete the vendor security assessment by Friday, 12 Nov:

Thanks — this is helpful. A couple of follow-ups before we close: 

1) Can you confirm whether the SBOM signature uses a hardware-backed key (HSM) or a software key, and whether the signing key is rotated regularly? We require either HSM-backed keys or a documented compensating control.
2) For subprocessors that touch aggregated telemetry (LogLake Inc., observability vendors), please indicate whether they have access to pseudonymized identifiers or plaintext identifiers.
3) Is there a public key or fingerprint we can use to verify the cosign signature programmatically? If so, please provide the key or a link to the keyserver.

Also cc'ing our Data Protection Officer (dpo@medsecure.com) to confirm acceptable formats for long-term retention. If it's easier, we can accept a signed PDF attestation now and finalize SBOM verification details next week.

— Alex

Hi Alex — final notes from our side.

- SBOM signing: we use cosign; the signing key is stored in our KMS with HSM-backed keys (AWS KMS with Multi-Region Keys). Key rotation schedule: 90 days for signing subkeys; master key rotation policy is every 365 days. We'll share the public key fingerprint and an automated verification script.
- Telemetry access: LogLake Inc. and our managed observability partner (TraceWave) only have pseudonymized identifiers; no plaintext prompts or PII are exported to third parties. We enforce field-level redaction before any external telemetry export.
- Public key: https://keys.redwood-inference.com/cosign.pub (fingerprint: SHA256:AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOpQrStUvWxYz0123456789+/=)

I've attached the concise verification steps and a short README for your engineering team. If you need DocuSign for the attestation, Aditya will route through Legal — otherwise the attached PDF is signed by our Compliance Head.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security & Trust | Redwood Inference
